accepted_costs.column_asymmetry: query_cell returns Ok(None) above column 255, so a malformed worksheet storing a record beyond it would be reported by the walk and unreachable by a query; no corpus fixture does this and the differential test asserts it
accepted_costs.host: eight measurement agents shared the host; quiescence is not established and the 1-minute load average was 8.27 at the end of the timing window
accepted_costs.instruction_residue: the existing operations are +0.011% to +0.146% instructions, which the record calls unchanged rather than improved
accepted_costs.modelled_extrapolation: the 24.6 s whole-sheet per-cell figure rests on three measured points that are linear to within 5%, not on a measured 38,950-position run
accepted_costs.review_triggers: two of 36 paired comparisons exceed +5%, both on WithCustomViews.xls file-source open and list in one direction only, both inside the same cell's B/B floor, and both on operations that never enter the code this change touched
accepted_costs.third_scan_loop: scan_text_sheet was deliberately not folded into the shared loop, so source.rs now has three worksheet scan loops where it had two; full text already scanned each sheet once, so unifying it would have risked moving a refusal for no measured gain
accepted_costs.wall_clock_noise: the B/B floor reaches 46.51% on the 54016 walk at 30 samples, so no latency statement about the walk, the per-cell reading or full text is admissible beyond the ratios, which exceed that floor by an order of magnitude

accepted_evidence.corpus_walk_differential: the same 126 fixtures at worksheet indices 0, 1 and 2 under --operation all-cells, whose oracle re-reads up to 128 reported positions one selected-cell query at a time and fails the run on any disagreement: 291 worksheets, 90,543 cells, zero disagreements
accepted_evidence.counters: 3 fixtures x 2 in-memory source modes x open/list/one-cell, before against after: reads, read bytes, source-version observations, len calls and seeks identical to the byte, with every sample within a cell asserted identical while folding
accepted_evidence.differential: the harness computes its all-cells oracle outside the timed region by walking the sheet and re-reading a bounded prefix of the reported positions one query at a time, and fails the run on any disagreement; every all-cells measurement in the record is therefore a passing differential
accepted_evidence.hardware_counters: perf stat cycles, instructions, branches, branch misses, isolated the same way

reason_codes: item XLS-3 of change 0587 has two halves and the survey separated them: the whole-sheet iterator needs no design record, the retained index does; this change implements the first and freezes the second

the brief's gate for implementing part (2) was 'value-identical and the retention accounting in place'; the value-identity half is achievable under the rule that only complete successful scans are retained, but the accounting half is not: ADR 0005's weighted, bounded, evictable cache has no implementation anywhere in this repository and the measured weight is 623 KB-935 KB for one worksheet of a 984 KB fixture
part (1) removes the index's motivating case: reading many cells of one worksheet is now one scan with zero retention, at 32.3 bytes per cell against 617,079.3
closes change 0568's third limitation, carried unaddressed for 37 records: the source-backed API had no whole-sheet iterator, so a full cell scan was N independent one-cell queries

the first working version of the shared loop cost +1.37% instructions on the 54016 one-cell query; folding the sink's four constant arguments into a ScanContext recovered it to +0.011%, and the three trial profiles are retained rather than discarded
title: One validated scan for a whole XLS worksheet, and a frozen design for the retained sheet index
withheld: any speedup of an existing operation
any cold-cache, physical-device, range-source, peak-RSS, allocation-profile, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result
any wall-clock claim for the walk, the per-cell reading or full text beyond their ratios
